title: A failed comfy install leaves an engine that passes every check and cannot boot
description: RELEASE BLOCKER for 1.3.0 - user decision 2026-07-31. THE TRIGGER IS ORDINARY, NOT AN EDGE CASE: the first engine install is multi-GB and long, so a user who quits partway through and comes back later hits this. The routing bug is independent of WHY the install stopped - MpiEngineInstall.js:316-324 chooses Install-vs-Repair on /engine/status, which goes true as soon as the VENV PYTHON exists (step 1, long before ComfyUI is cloned or stamped), so Retry is sent to /engine/repair-deps, which installs custom nodes, REPORTS SUCCESS, never re-runs comfy install, never installs ComfyUI core requirements and never stamps. ComfyUI then dies on ModuleNotFoundError: No module named sqlalchemy with no in-app escape. NOTE MPI-408 and MPI-411 do NOT cover this - they fixed "an interrupted install can retry"; this is "Retry goes to the wrong endpoint and lies about the result". LIKELY MINIMAL FIX (verify, do not assume): route on /engine/version-check (installed !== null) instead of /engine/status, make repair-deps refuse and hand back to /engine/download when there is no stamp, and stamp on every success path. Found live on Linux 2026-07-31, downstream of MPI-411 - this is the DETECTION/RECOVERY gap, not the cause. Chain: comfy install exits 1 before installing ComfyUI core requirements (MPI-411), so _runEngineDownload throws and step 5 never writes engine/.mpi_engine_version (engine.js:535-544). The user presses Retry; MpiEngineInstall.js:316-324 routes on /engine/status, which is true as soon as the VENV PYTHON exists - on the uv path that is from step 1, long before ComfyUI is cloned or stamped - so Retry goes to /engine/repair-deps, which installs custom nodes and their requirements, reports SUCCESS, and never re-runs comfy install, never installs ComfyUI core requirements, never stamps. Measured end state: /engine/status exists true, /engine/deps-status needsDepsInstall false with zero missing/drifted, a real clone with main.py + .git + 16 custom nodes, a venv with 359 packages including torch 2.13.0+cu130 - and /engine/version-check installed null needsInstall true, and ComfyUI dies on ModuleNotFoundError: No module named sqlalchemy. The deps install genuinely succeeded (node commit marker stamped for comfyui_controlnet_aux at 00:48:28) and still left no stamp, so a SUCCESSFUL pass produces an unusable engine with no in-app recovery - the only escape found was hand-writing the stamp file, which no user would discover, and even that was not enough because ComfyUI requirements were still missing. Two holes: the stamp is only ever written by _runEngineDownload, and engineReady asks the wrong question on the uv path (python presence does not imply ComfyUI is installed; on Windows they arrive in one archive so the test holds, on Linux/macOS they are separate steps). Fix direction: make readiness a real capability test rather than a file check, make repair-deps either able to repair the engine or refuse and hand back to /engine/download, and stamp on every success path.

attention.reason: Proven live on macOS 2026-07-31 against the shipped 1.3.0 artifact: interrupted first install, real Retry press reached /engine/download, recovered to a stamped booting 0.29.2 engine with 0 IMPORT FAILED. Ready to close on approval.
